title: Mending Table
description: Mending can appear when enchanting compatible items at the enchanting table.
body:
📖 Mending Table
Tired of the Librarian trade-resetting marathon? Bring Mending back to the Enchanting Table.

By integrating Mending directly into the standard enchanting pool, it makes the Enchanting Table relevant again for late-game gear.

🛠️ Key Features
Table Integration: Adds Mending I to the potential enchantment list when using an Enchanting Table.

Balanced Progression: Optimized for Level 30 enchantments, ensuring you still have to "earn" your gear through XP grinding.

Vanilla Compatible: Fully respects enchantment conflicts. You still cannot have Mending and Infinity on the same bow, maintaining the game's original balance.

🌟 Why Choose This Mod?
Kill the "Villager Meta": Stop kidnapping villagers and forcing them into 1x1 holes just to get a single book.

Play Your Way: Perfect for survival players who want a "Vanilla+" experience without the tedious RNG of trade-refreshing.

🚀 How to Install

Down the File.

Drop it into your mods folder (for Fabric).

Restart/Reload your game.

Start enchanting and look for that elusive purple glow!
